text: Furu ike ya kawazu tobikomu mizu no oto.
Chiri mo tsumoreba yama to naru.

source: Kotowaza (Fall seven times, stand up eight)

text: Ichi-go ichi-e: deai o taisetsu ni shi, kondo koso saigo to omotte seii o tsukusu.
Senri no michi mo ippo kara.
source: Kotowaza (A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step)

text: Bushido to wa shinu koto to mitsuketari.
Katte kabuto no o o shimeyo.
source: Samurai Maxim (Tighten your helmet strap after victory)

text: Kokoro koso taisetsu na koto de aru. Katachi dake de wa nani mo umarenai.
Shizukesa ya iwa ni shimiiru semi no koe.
